panels.title: Acquisition failure rate
panels.description: Share of attempts that failed to obtain a usable connection. Pool exhaustion can occur while PostgreSQL is healthy.

panels.title: Acquisition failures
panels.description: Attempts that failed to obtain a usable connection in the selected time range.

targets.expr:
(sum (
  last_over_time(kochwiki_postgresql_connection_acquisition_duration_seconds_count{job="personal/kochwiki", deployment_environment_name="$environment", deployment_environment_name!="", outcome="operational_failure"}[$__range])
  - (kochwiki_postgresql_connection_acquisition_duration_seconds_count{job="personal/kochwiki", deployment_environment_name="$environment", deployment_environment_name!="", outcome="operational_failure"} offset $__range or 0 * last_over_time(kochwiki_postgresql_connection_acquisition_duration_seconds_count{job="personal/kochwiki", deployment_environment_name="$environment", deployment_environment_name!="", outcome="operational_failure"}[$__range]))
)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Acquisition attempts
panels.description: All attempts to obtain a usable connection in the selected time range.

panels.title: Operational failure rate by query pattern
panels.description: Operational failures divided by all observed executions. Constraint violations count toward executions.
